name: stale_aggregate
description: In `ship_lineitem`, `Order.o_totalprice` is a cached aggregate that is never recalculated when line items are modified (e.g., discounts, prices change via other endpoints), yet `get_order` returns this stale `o_totalprice` without computing it from current lineitem rows. The `o_latest_shipdate` update in `ship_lineitem` only covers one specific case, but `o_totalprice` remains unupdated and serves as a stale summary.
